summary: Managed tenants create administrators again, and administrators sent by your provider are no longer reported as missing.

fixes.title: Managed tenants create administrators again
fixes.text: In the previous version the administrator job on a managed tenant failed every run, so sent administrators were never created. It runs again.

fixes.title: Provider administrators are no longer flagged
fixes.text: Pending changes reported delegations naming your provider's administrators as errors on a managed tenant. They now count as defined; truly undefined accounts are still reported.

fixes.title: Admin naming comes from tenant settings
fixes.text: A tenant's own administrator naming setting now wins over the deployment value, and any disagreement is noted in the job log.
